Blend Predictions With Their Nearest Reference Plots

Source: R/resolve.R
resolve.retrieval.Rd

Retrieval augmentation (Gorishniy et al. 2024, TabR): from now on every prediction of predictor is blended with the labels of the plot's k nearest reference plots in the model's latent space (cosine similarity, weighted by a softmax of similarity over temperature): (1 - alpha) * prediction + alpha * retrieved, a regression target in original units, a classification target as class probabilities (the neighbours' label distribution), its class the most probable one. Only the neighbours labelled for a target count for it; a plot with none keeps the model's prediction.

Usage

resolve.retrieval(
  predictor,
  reference,
  kNeighbors = NULL,
  alpha = NULL,
  temperature = NULL,
  batchSize = 4096L
)

Arguments

predictor

A Predictor from resolve.load().

reference

The reference plots, normally the training plots: a ResolveDataset built in the model's namespace (vocabs = predictor$vocabs()) that carries every target of the model. NULL removes a retrieval set before.

kNeighbors

Reference plots each prediction reads.

alpha

Share of the neighbours' labels in the blend, in [0, 1].

temperature

Softmax temperature over the neighbours' cosine similarities (smaller puts the weight on the nearest).

batchSize

Chunk size of the forward pass that encodes the reference plots (default 4096).

Value

The predictor, invisibly.

Details

Settings left NULL take the RESOLVE engine's defaults (resolve.default_config() "retrieval"). A reference plot that is also scored retrieves itself first.

Examples

plots <- system.file("extdata", "plots.csv", package = "resolveR")
species <- system.file("extdata", "species.csv", package = "resolveR")
roles <- list(plot_id = "plot_id", species_id = "species", abundance = "cover",
              genus = "genus", family = "family", latitude = "lat", longitude = "lon")
targets <- list(elevation = list(column = "elevation", task = "regression"),
                habitat = list(column = "habitat", task = "classification"))
dataset <- resolve.dataset.csv(plots, species, roles = roles, targets = targets)
path <- file.path(tempdir(), "model.pt")
fit <- resolve.train.dataset(dataset, maxEpochs = 20L, savePath = path, verbose = FALSE)

predictor <- resolve.load(path)
new_plots <- resolve.dataset.csv(plots, species, roles = roles,
                                 vocabs = predictor$vocabs(),
                                 config = predictor$dataset_config())
reference <- resolve.dataset.csv(plots, species, roles = roles, targets = targets,
                                 vocabs = predictor$vocabs(),
                                 config = predictor$dataset_config())
resolve.retrieval(predictor, reference, kNeighbors = 8L, alpha = 0.3)
preds <- resolve.predict.dataset(predictor, new_plots)
head(preds$predictions$elevation)
